title: Paper Claim (Direct Member Reimbursement) Terms — Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit
content:
A member who paid for a prescription themselves may file a paper claim, also called a direct member reimbursement, under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit. The terms below are set by the member's network.

| | Northbridge Performance Network | Northbridge Essential Network | Northbridge National Network | Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | Northbridge Retail90 Network | Northbridge Open Choice Network |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filing limit, calendar days after the date of service | 90 | 180 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| Decision and payment time, calendar days from receipt | 30 | 30 | 21 | 21 | 14 | 14 |
| Pricing basis | Network rate less cost share | Network rate less cost share | Network rate less cost share | Network rate less cost share | Network rate less cost share | Network rate less cost share |
| Minimum payment, USD | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| Itemized pharmacy receipt required | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Emergency fills purchased outside the United States may be reimbursed | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Payment methods | Check | Check | Check | Check or direct deposit | Check or direct deposit | Check or direct deposit |

## Meaning of the terms

- **Pricing basis — network rate less cost share**: a paper claim is priced at the network allowed amount (or the out-of-network allowed amount) for the drug, capped at what the member paid, less the member cost share the plan would have charged.
- **Minimum payment**: a reimbursement below 1.00 USD is approved, but no payment is issued.
- **Itemized pharmacy receipt**: the receipt shows the drug, NDC, quantity, days supply and amount paid.
- **Payment methods**: where direct deposit is offered, it is used when banking details are on file.

## Questions the terms answer

- **How long does a member on the Northbridge Essential Network have to file?** 180 calendar days after the date of service.
- **Which networks may reimburse an emergency fill bought abroad?** The Northbridge Preferred Savings, Retail90 and Open Choice Networks.
- **Within how many days is a paper claim decided on the Northbridge Retail90 Network?** 14 calendar days from receipt.
